FROM concert

    FROM stadium

);
FINAL SQL:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM concert 
WHERE Stadium_ID = (
    SELECT Stadium_ID 
    FROM stadium 
    WHERE Capacity = (SELECT MAX(Capacity) FROM stadium)
);
